papers.caution: T4 COLUMN-ORDER AMBIGUITY: the extracted header order (α_Band, α_SBPL, Δ_SBPL, δDIC, p_eff^Band, p_eff^SBPL, p_B^Band, p_B^synch) does not match the body, where position 6 goes negative across bursts and positions 4-5 are always ~3-35. Body order is almost certainly α_Band, α_SBPL, Δ_SBPL, p_eff^Band, p_eff^SBPL, δDIC, p_B^Band, p_B^synch. α's, Δ_SBPL and the two p_B's are unambiguous; δDIC/p_eff carry the caveat. papers.why_it_matters: This is the one paper in the burst's record that makes a physical-model claim about our exact interval — and it is a claim our engine can contradict or confirm.
